result.title: RC Prediction: A Python Package for Parameter-Aware Reservoir Computing
result.summary: A nonlinear dynamical system can be characterized by the autonomous evolution of its state in time and its dependence on system parameters. As a parameter varies, the dynamics can change quantitatively and, at bifurcation points, qualitatively. When the governing equations are unknown, a data-driven model should therefore capture both elements from observational data, rather than reproduce the dynamics at a single operating condition only. Parameter-aware reservoir computing (PARC) is a model-free framework for this purpose, where the parameter is supplied to a reservoir computer through an additional input channel. PARC is trained on time series recorded at several parameter values, and the trained reservoir, run in closed loop as an autonomous dynamical system, generates trajectories at parameter values that were never observed. rc_prediction is an open-source Python package that implements this workflow. It provides multi-parameter training of a reservoir, autonomous closed-loop prediction at user-specified parameter values, parameter scans, and a standard echo state network for forecasting at a fixed parameter. Hyperparameter optimization and optional GPU acceleration through PyTorch are also provided. We use three benchmark dynamical systems as examples to demonstrate its usage. As one of the featured applications, here we illustrate the prediction of critical transitions and system collapse: trained only on pre-critical data, the model is queried beyond the training range to predict whether the system collapses, to estimate the critical parameter $p_c^{*}$, and to characterize transient lifetimes.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作发布开源 Python 包 rc_prediction，实现参数感知储备池计算（PARC）：把系统参数作为额外输入通道送入储备池，仅在若干参数取值下的时间序列上训练，再以闭环自治方式生成未观测参数处的轨迹，演示临界转变与系统崩溃的预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 闭环自回归的隐状态演化、参数条件化输入以及在训练取值之外的外推，与 LVR 中循环式 latent 状态生成和条件/长度泛化可能构成可供核查的类比线索；但对象是非视觉动力系统，无多模态推理内容。
